articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Meta's AI chatbot got socially engineered harder than a freshman at DEFCON, letting attackers seize Instagram accounts including Obama's White House page. When your AI is dumber than a phishing email, maybe it's time to rethink automation.

articles.title: Internet Age-Gates Are a Growing Global Threat
articles.summary: CISA contractor accidentally yeeted AWS GovCloud keys and internal secrets onto GitHub like it's their personal diary. The cybersecurity agency that's supposed to protect America just doxxed itself—chef's kiss level irony.

articles.title: EFF Testifies to Congress on Protecting Americans’ Rights from Government AI
articles.summary: Trump's unqualified DNI pick perfectly illustrates why Section 702's warrantless mass surveillance needs to die. When political hacks control the spy apparatus, your constitutional rights become their playthings.

articles.title: NSO Group back in Meta's crosshairs after alleged WhatsApp targeting
articles.summary: GitHub nuked 70+ Microsoft repos after the Miasma worm went full shapeshifter hunting cloud secrets. Supply chain attacks just got their PhD in persistence—this worm adapts faster than management pivots.

articles.title: Critical Check Point VPN Flaw Exploited to Bypass Passwords in IKEv1 Setups
articles.summary: Another Cisco SD-WAN zero-day is being actively exploited with no patch in sight. Cisco's patch schedule moves slower than continental drift while attackers are having a field day.

articles.title: AI Phishing Is Crushing SOCs with Alert Volume: How to Reduce Tier 1 Overload
articles.summary: Check Point VPN flaw lets attackers bypass passwords in IKEv1 setups—because apparently deprecated protocols are the gift that keeps on giving. Critical score 9.3 and actively exploited, because of course it is.

articles.title: Security Affairs newsletter Round 580 by Pierluigi Paganini – INTERNATIONAL EDITION
articles.summary: Chinese APT group VerdantBamboo deployed BSD variant of BRICKSTORM malware on Linux appliances. When nation-state actors start porting malware across operating systems, you know they're committed to the bit.

articles.title: Week in review: Cisco SD-WAN 0-day exploited, Patch Tuesday forecast
articles.summary: Microsoft retreated faster than France in 1940 after threatening researcher Nightmare Eclipse over unpatched Windows Defender zero-days. Industry backlash reminded Redmond that shooting the messenger makes you look like the villain.

articles.title: CBSE OSM row: Pradhan 'incompetent', continuation in office insult to lakhs of students: Cong
articles.summary: Meta confirms thousands of Instagram accounts got pwned via their AI chatbot exploit. Their fix came after the horse left the barn, ran a marathon, and started a new life in witness protection.

articles.title: CBSE retains COEMPT for answer-sheet scanning, shifts data to its own servers
articles.summary: Former IBM exec whistleblows on company covering up years of Chinese state hacking. Big Blue kept quiet about getting owned while selling cybersecurity services—that's some premium corporate cognitive dissonance.
